_comment: Gale waving classes for vanilla. Most vanilla blocks are found by class (leaves, bushes, vines, kelp, seagrass); this file names the rest and the exceptions. Resource packs and mods can add files under assets/<namespace>/waving/. Entries: block id, id[property=value,...], namespace:* or #namespace:tag (tags arrive with the server's tag packet at login). Precedence, lowest first: class heuristics, tags, block ids, the waving.blacklist option. Later packs win; "replace": true ignores lower packs' copies of the same file.
